# Fatahul Ahmad Dzikri - Portfolio & Profile

> Fatahul Ahmad Dzikri (also known as `dzkrii` or `kyuradev`) is a Creative Developer and Software Developer based in Indonesia. He specializes in crafting high-performance, structured, and visually distinctive web and mobile applications using modern frameworks such as React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Laravel, and Flutter.
